title: Generation of the selected unit-root fraction field
statement: For the selected local unit-root diagram, the chosen fraction field F' is generated as an A'-algebra by the image of F.

proof.text: Form C=A[X]/(X^e-v) and B=T[X]/(X^e-v_T). Both polynomials are monic of positive degree. The map T->B is finite and injective, so integral lying over gives a maximal ideal q above m_T. Contract q along the coefficient-induced map C->B to p. Locality of A->T gives p contracted to A equals m_A.

Apply [lem-sbc-dvr-unit-root-at-prime] to p over A and q over T, mapping invertibility of e to T. Set A'=C_p and T'=B_q. The theorem supplies their domain and DVR structures, local horizontal maps and injectivity of T->T'. Localization.localRingHom supplies the local vertical map and its equality on C proves square commutativity and equality of the root images. The quotient root relation gives r^e=v.

The root of C is a unit because its e-th power is v; the derivative evaluates to e times its (e-1)-st power, also a unit. Identify C with the standard-etale algebra of the pair (X^e-v, derivative) via root evaluation and its inverse. Thus C/A is etale. Formal unramifiedness and essential finite type persist after localization. Mathlib Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal gives m_A A'=m_A'.

Take F'=Frac(T'). Compose the injection T->T' with T'->F' and extend it using IsFractionRing.lift to iF:F->F'. Its defining equality on T and the square equality prove both required coefficient compatibilities.

Let x be the root image in F' and E the intermediate field F(x), with F-algebra structure induced by iF. The monic root equation shows x integral over F, so E.toSubalgebra=F[x]. Polynomial induction puts the image of every element of B in E. Every element of B_q is a quotient of such images, hence lies in E, and the same is true of its fraction field. Thus E=F'. Finally adjoin induction places F[x] in the A'-algebra generated by iF(F): its coefficients belong to iF(F) and x comes from r in A'. This proves the required algebra is top.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BRM, first unit-root claim; concrete root algebras and prime localizations, followed by the selected field-factor generation argument.

mathlib_searches.query: An etale extension of a discrete valuation ring obtained by adjoining a root of a unit
Adjoin an e-th root of a unit in a discrete valuation ring by an etale extension and lift a local map of DVRs
mathlib_searches.results: StandardEtalePair.lift, lift_X, homEquiv and the standard-etale instances were returned. None constructs the local DVR square or its fraction-field generation.
Found the standard-etale API and isDedekindDomain.of_formallyUnramified. The latter needs an already specified finite domain.

theorem dvr_unit_root_weakly_unramified_diagram
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    (e : ℕ) (hepos : 0 < e) (he : IsUnit (e : A)) (v : Aˣ)
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [IsDiscreteValuationRing T]
    [Algebra A T] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A T)]
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra A F] [Algebra T F]
    [IsFractionRing T F] [IsScalarTower A T F] :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : IsDomain A')
      (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing A') (aAA' : Algebra A A'),
    letI := aAA'
    ∃ (hAA' : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A A')) (r : A'),
    letI := hAA'
    r ^ e = algebraMap A A' (v : A) ∧
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A A') = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A' ∧
    ∃ (T' : Type u) (_ : CommRing T') (_ : IsDomain T')
      (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing T') (aTT' : Algebra T T') (aA'T' : Algebra A' T'),
    letI := aTT'
    letI := aA'T'
    ∃ (_ : IsLocalHom (algebraMap T T')) (_ : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A' T')),
    (∀ a : A, algebraMap T T' (algebraMap A T a) =
      algebraMap A' T' (algebraMap A A' a)) ∧
    ∃ (F' : Type u) (_ : Field F') (aA'F' : Algebra A' F') (aT'F' : Algebra T' F'),
    letI := aA'F'
    letI := aT'F'
    ∃ (_ : IsFractionRing T' F') (_ : IsScalarTower A' T' F') (iF : F →+* F'),
    (∀ a : A, iF (algebraMap A F a) = algebraMap A' F' (algebraMap A A' a)) ∧
    (∀ t : T, iF (algebraMap T F t) = algebraMap T' F' (algebraMap T T' t)) ∧
    Algebra.adjoin A' (Set.range iF) = ⊤
